english:
Stowing a weapon after scoring a Weapon Kill against a Player or against an enemy of the <link Elite tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> restores 40 HP and disorients Combatants within 12 meters for 4 seconds.

3 second cooldown between activations.
